subject: Insurance
title: The Deepwater Horizon Explosion
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: The Deepwater Horizon Explosion.

hook.text: In 2010, the Deepwater Horizon oil rig exploded in the Gulf of Mexico, killing 11 workers.

buildup.text: Oil gushed for 87 days. 210 million gallons poured into the Gulf—the largest marine oil spill in history.

twist.text: The disaster bankrupted BP's insurance pool. Reinsurers paid billions.

climax.text: Deepwater Horizon proved that self-insurance fails at catastrophic scale.

quiz.question: Why did BP pay most of the Deepwater Horizon costs itself?
options: BP self-insured most operations and was underinsured
